# Folder-order cleanup includes a behavior fix and later source differences

The folder-drag cleanup also repairs a preexisting comparison of wrapper.name, which did not name the wrapped folder. Review calls out that repair explicitly. The literal landing still contains sortOder and a positive SpecialUse filter despite its skip comment. At the fixed accepted revision, setSortOrderOnNewFolder uses a negated SpecialUse filter, FolderUtils.compareFolders and localizedName. Preserve those source differences when reusing the patch; approval alone does not establish every expression as correct. The comparator internals and linked later regressions remain outside this audit. No folder drag or ordering test ran.

Scope: Folder ordering.
